title: Set 82

sentences.ko: 토요일에 두어 시간만 이사 도와주겠다고 언니한테 말했는데, 해가 진 뒤까지도 짐을 나르고 있었어. 부엌은 아예 하나도 안 싸 놨더라고. 게다가 뭘 남길지 정하느라 자꾸 멈추고. 그래서 일요일엔 진짜 아무것도 안 했어. 하나도 미안하지 않아.
sentences.text: I told my sister I'd help her move for a couple of hours on Saturday, and we were still carrying stuff out after dark, because she hadn't packed the kitchen at all. And she kept stopping to decide what she was keeping. So I did absolutely nothing on Sunday, and I don't feel bad about it.

alts.text: I said I'd give my sister a couple of hours on Saturday to help her move, and we were still hauling stuff out after dark, because she hadn't packed the kitchen at all. And she kept stopping to decide what she was keeping. So yeah, I did nothing on Sunday, and I'm not sorry about it.

I had agreed to help my sister move for a couple of hours on Saturday, and we were still carrying things out after dark, because she had not packed the kitchen at all. She also kept stopping to decide what she was keeping. As a result, I did absolutely nothing on Sunday, and I do not feel bad about it.

sentences.note: **for a couple of hours** 는 정확히 두 시간이 아니라 두어 시간, 잠깐이라는 뜻입니다. **after dark** 는 해가 지고 난 뒤를 말합니다.

sentences.ko: 위층 애가 토요일 일곱 시에 집 이쪽 끝에서 저쪽 끝까지 뛰어다녀. 우리 침실이 바로 그 밑이고. 두 번이나 얘기했는데 그때마다 어찌나 좋게 받아 주는지, 이제 또 말 꺼내면 내가 못된 사람 되는 기분이야. 제일 최악은, 걔가 뛰기 시작하기도 전에 잠이 깨서 그냥 누운 채로 기다리고 있다는 거야.
sentences.text: Their kid runs the whole length of the apartment at seven on a Saturday, and our bedroom is right underneath. I've talked to them twice and they're so nice about it every time, so now I feel like the bad guy for bringing it up again. And the worst part is I've started waking up before he even gets going, just lying there waiting for it.

alts.text: The kid above us goes tearing from one end of the apartment to the other at seven on a Saturday, and our bedroom is right underneath. I've brought it up twice and they're so nice about it every time, so now I'm the bad guy if I say anything again. And the worst part? I've started waking up before he even gets going, just lying there waiting for it.

Their child runs the entire length of the apartment at seven on a Saturday, and our bedroom is directly beneath. I have spoken to them twice, and they are very gracious about it each time, so I now feel like the villain for raising it again. The worst part is that I have begun waking up before he even starts, simply lying there waiting for it.

sentences.note: **the bad guy** 는 나쁜 놈이라기보다 괜히 트집 잡는 사람이 된 것 같은 기분을 말합니다. **gets going** 은 본격적으로 시작한다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 그 태국 음식집에 시켰는데 남의 집 가족 주문을 통째로 보냈어. 국수가 네 통에, 영수증엔 내 이름도 아닌 이름이 찍혀 있고. 전화했더니 그냥 드시라고 하면서 우리 시킨 건 지금 보내 주는 중이래. 그래서 냉장고가 꽉 찼어. 좀 줄까? 진심이야, 와서 가져가.
sentences.text: We ordered from that Thai place and they sent us somebody's whole family order, like four containers of noodles and a receipt with a name that isn't mine. And I called and the guy said just keep it, and he's sending ours out now, so the fridge is completely full. Do you want some? I'm serious, come take it.

alts.text: So that Thai place sent us somebody's whole family order, like four containers of noodles and a receipt with a name that isn't mine. And I called and the guy goes just keep it, and he's sending ours out now, so the fridge is packed. You want some? I'm serious, come get it.

We ordered from that Thai restaurant, and they sent us another family's entire order, including four containers of noodles and a receipt with a name that is not mine. I called, and the man said we should simply keep it, and he is sending ours out now, so the refrigerator is completely full. Would you like some? I am serious, please come and take it.

sentences.note: **just keep it** 은 돌려주지 말고 그냥 가지시라, 그냥 드시라는 뜻입니다. 이름 모르는 남자 직원을 가리킬 때 **the guy** 라고 가볍게 부릅니다.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

sentences.ko: 색은 진짜 잘 어울려, 진심이야. 근데 어깨 쪽이 좀 이상하게 떠. 그건 수선으로도 못 고치는 부분이거든. 한 치수 작은 거 있었어? 나 같으면 택 붙어 있을 때 지금 바꾸겠어. 그거 입어 보고도 이게 더 마음에 들면 내가 틀린 거니까 그냥 이거 해.
sentences.text: The color's great on you, I mean that, but it's sitting funny in the shoulders and that's the one thing you can't really get fixed. Did they have the next size down? Because I'd swap it now while the tags are still on. And if you try that one and you still like this one better, then I'm wrong and you should keep it.

alts.text: Honestly, that color looks amazing on you, and I mean that, but it's sitting weird in the shoulders and that's the one thing you can't really get fixed. Did they have it a size down? Because I'd swap it now while the tags are still on. And if you try that one and you still like this one better, then I'm wrong and you should keep it.

The color is wonderful on you, and I mean that sincerely, but it does not sit properly in the shoulders, and that is the one thing that cannot really be altered. Did they have the next size down? I would exchange it now, while the tags are still attached. And if you try that one and you still prefer this one, then I am wrong and you should keep it.

sentences.note: 옷이 몸에 어떻게 맞는지를 말할 때 sit 을 씁니다. **sitting funny in the shoulders** 는 어깨선이 어색하게 맞는다는 뜻입니다. **the next size down** 은 한 치수 작은 것입니다.
sentences.situation: 친구가 산 옷 어떠냐고 물었을 때 솔직하게 말하기

sentences.ko: 드디어 손목 때문에 병원에 갔어. 얼마나 오래 아팠는지 할 말을 잔뜩 준비해 갔는데, 의사가 내 타자 치는 걸 십 초쯤 보더니 그냥 의자를 어떻게 놓고 쓰는지가 문제라고 하더라. 그게 진료 전부였어. 그 말 들으려고 대기실에 사십 분 앉아 있었고, 지금은 집에서 책상 자리 옮기고 있어.
sentences.text: I finally went in about my wrist, and I had this whole speech ready about how long it's been bothering me, and the doctor watched me type for about ten seconds and said it's just how my chair is set up. That was the whole visit. I sat in that waiting room for forty minutes to hear that, and now I'm home moving my desk around.

alts.text: So I finally got my wrist looked at, and I had this whole speech ready about how long it's been bugging me, and the doctor watched me type for about ten seconds and said it's just how my chair is set up. That was it. Forty minutes in that waiting room to hear that, and now I'm home shoving my desk around.

I finally had my wrist seen to, and I had prepared an entire speech about how long it has been bothering me, and the doctor watched me type for about ten seconds and said that it is simply the way my chair is arranged. That was the whole visit. I sat in that waiting room for forty minutes to hear that, and I am now at home rearranging my desk.

sentences.note: **had this whole speech ready** 는 할 말을 머릿속에 잔뜩 준비해 뒀다는 뜻입니다. **how my chair is set up** 은 의자를 어떤 높이와 자리로 맞춰 놓고 쓰는지를 말합니다.
sentences.situation: 병원 갔다 온 얘기 가볍게 하기

reviewed: 3번 한국어: 우리 주문은 아직 온 적이 없는데 "다시 보내 준대" 라고 해서 영어(he's sending ours out now)와 어긋났습니다. "우리 시킨 건 지금 보내 주는 중이래" 로 고쳤습니다.
3번 formal: telephoned / the gentleman / I am quite serious 가 식당 배달 얘기에 쓰기엔 지나치게 굳은 옛말투라 말투만 올리는 선을 넘었습니다. called / the man / I am serious 로 낮추고 뜻은 그대로 두었습니다.
